# NormaHub FastAPI AI Enterprise Starter - Full Technical Documentation
> Complete architectural specification, API reference, schemas, and implementation guide for the High-Load Enterprise AI Gateway.

## 1. System Architecture

```text
[Client Applications: Web, Mobile, Telegram, Microservices]
                         │
                         ▼
        [FastAPI Gateway: Port 8000 (uvicorn)]
  ┌──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┐
  │  Latency & TTFT      │   CORS & Tracing    │
  │  Middleware          │   Request-ID Inject │
  └──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┘
                         │
        ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐
        ▼                                 ▼
   [/v1/chat/*]                      [/v1/rag/*]
        │                                 │
        ▼                                 ▼
  [Semantic Cache]               [Hybrid RAG Engine]
  ├─ Vector Cosine Sim           ├─ BM25 Tokenizer
  ├─ Redis / In-Memory           ├─ Dense Vector Search
  └─ Up to 70% Token Savings     └─ Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
        │                                 │
        └────────────────┬────────────────┘
                         ▼
             [Resilient Gateway Client]
             ├─ Circuit Breaker (CLOSED / OPEN / HALF-OPEN)
             ├─ Exponential Backoff Retry (429 / 5xx)
             └─ Automatic Fallback Model Failover
                         │
                         ▼
       [NormaHub API: https://api.normahub.cc/v1]
         (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5.5, DeepSeek v4.1)
```

## 2. Environment Variables & Configuration

- `NORMAHUB_API_KEY` (string, required): API key obtained from https://normahub.cc
- `NORMAHUB_BASE_URL` (string, default: "https://api.normahub.cc/v1"): OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- `DEFAULT_MODEL` (string, default: "gpt-6-astra"): Primary LLM model.
- `FALLBACK_MODEL` (string, default: "claude-sonnet-5-5"): Secondary model upon gateway failure.
- `EMBEDDING_MODEL` (string, default: "text-embedding-3-small"): Vector embeddings model.
- `REDIS_URL` (string, default: "redis://localhost:6379/0"): Redis connection string.
- `CACHE_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` (float, default: 0.92): Cosine threshold for semantic cache hit.
- `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` (int, default: 86400): TTL in seconds for cached entries.
- `CIRCUIT_BREAKER_FAILURE_THRESHOLD` (int, default: 5): Consecutive failures to trip circuit.
- `CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RECOVERY_SECONDS` (float, default: 30.0): Cooldown before half-open probe.
- `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (float, default: 60.0): Per-request HTTP client timeout.
- `GATEWAY_MAX_RETRIES` (int, default: 3): Max retry attempts for transient errors.
- `RAG_VECTOR_WEIGHT` (float, default: 0.7): Weight for dense vector retrieval.
- `RAG_BM25_WEIGHT` (float, default: 0.3): Weight for sparse BM25 retrieval.
- `RAG_TOP_K` (int, default: 5): Number of top context chunks injected into prompt.

## 3. REST API Specification

### 3.1 Chat Endpoints

#### POST /v1/chat/completions
Standard completion endpoint with semantic cache check and TTFT metadata.
Request Body:
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-6-astra",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are an enterprise AI assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Explain circuit breaker pattern in distributed systems."}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "use_cache": true
}
```
Response Body:
```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-normahub-...",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "model": "gpt-6-astra",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "The Circuit Breaker pattern is a design pattern used in distributed software systems..."
      },
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 28,
    "completion_tokens": 142,
    "total_tokens": 170
  },
  "cached": false,
  "ttft_ms": 182.4,
  "latency_ms": 420.1
}
```

#### POST /v1/chat/stream
Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming endpoint for high-throughput UIs.
Headers: `Accept: text/event-stream`
Stream chunks emit:
```text
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-stream-1","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"The"},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-stream-1","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" Circuit"},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-stream-1","choices":[{"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}],"usage":{"total_tokens":170},"ttft_ms":164.2}

data: [DONE]
```

### 3.2 RAG Endpoints

#### POST /v1/rag/index
Index documents into the knowledge base.
Request Body:
```json
{
  "documents": [
    {
      "id": "doc-cloud-sla",
      "title": "Enterprise Cloud SLA Policy",
      "content": "NormaHub provides 99.95% API uptime SLA with redundant gateway routing across multi-region edge points.",
      "metadata": {"department": "infrastructure", "version": "2026.1"}
    }
  ]
}
```

#### POST /v1/rag/query
Query knowledge base with hybrid retrieval and synthesis.
Request Body:
```json
{
  "query": "What is the guaranteed API uptime for NormaHub enterprise users?",
  "top_k": 3,
  "model": "gpt-6-astra",
  "temperature": 0.2
}
```
Response Body:
```json
{
  "answer": "NormaHub provides a 99.95% API uptime SLA with redundant gateway routing across multi-region edge points.",
  "citations": [
    {
      "document_id": "doc-cloud-sla",
      "title": "Enterprise Cloud SLA Policy",
      "score": 0.942,
      "snippet": "NormaHub provides 99.95% API uptime SLA..."
    }
  ],
  "retrieval_metrics": {
    "bm25_matches": 1,
    "vector_matches": 1,
    "fusion_method": "reciprocal_rank_fusion"
  },
  "ttft_ms": 178.6,
  "total_latency_ms": 521.3
}
```

### 3.3 Health and Metrics Endpoints

#### GET /v1/health
Returns component health, ping to NormaHub, Redis status, and rolling TTFT metrics.
Response:
```json
{
  "status": "healthy",
  "app_version": "1.0.0",
  "uptime_seconds": 3840.5,
  "normahub_gateway": {
    "status": "connected",
    "base_url": "https://api.normahub.cc/v1",
    "ping_ms": 32.4
  },
  "cache": {
    "backend": "redis",
    "status": "connected",
    "hit_count": 1420,
    "miss_count": 510,
    "hit_ratio": 0.735,
    "saved_tokens_approx": 1248000
  },
  "circuit_breaker": {
    "state": "CLOSED",
    "failure_count": 0,
    "last_failure": null
  },
  "latency": {
    "ttft_p50_ms": 174.2,
    "ttft_p95_ms": 289.0,
    "ttft_p99_ms": 412.5,
    "sample_count": 1930
  }
}
```

#### GET /metrics
Prometheus metrics format for scraping.

## 4. Semantic Caching Engine Design
1. Every user prompt is sanitized and vectorized using `text-embedding-3-small`.
2. Normalized vectors are queried against Redis / InMemory vector cache.
3. If max cosine similarity $\ge 0.92$, the stored assistant answer is returned immediately in $< 15$ ms.
4. Token savings are tracked and reported in health metrics.
5. In case of cache miss, the prompt is dispatched to NormaHub and response is asynchronously stored with TTL.

## 5. Circuit Breaker State Transition
- `CLOSED`: Normal operation. Requests pass directly to NormaHub.
- `OPEN`: Failures exceeded threshold (5 consecutive errors). Requests immediately fallback to secondary model or return 503 error without waiting for timeouts.
- `HALF-OPEN`: After recovery cooldown (30s), a single probe request is sent. If successful, resets to `CLOSED`; if failed, reverts to `OPEN`.
